disposition.ask: Whether a point is in a nonattainment area and, if so, which pollutants (ozone, PM2.5, PM10, CO, SO2, NO2, lead) and the severity classification (Marginal/Moderate/Serious/Severe/Extreme)
disposition.reason: This field identifies pollutants for which the point is in nonattainment, but does not break them out individually per pollutant or supply the severity classification separately — you must also pull air_quality_worst_classification for the classification tier, which applies only to ozone/CO, leaving PM/lead/SO2/NO2 unclassified.
disposition.description: Comma-joined distinct pollutant names for which the point is in a nonattainment area (e.g. "Ozone (2015),PM2.5 (2012)").
disposition.interpretation_hints: Identifies which criteria pollutants drive the permitting constraint — ozone nonattainment in particular gates NOx-emitting turbines and engines. Empty when the point is in no nonattainment area.

disposition.ask: The severity classification (Marginal/Moderate/Serious/Severe/Extreme) for ozone and CO nonattainment areas
disposition.reason: This field supplies the worst classification among ozone/CO matches only; it is explicitly blank for PM2.5/PM10/lead/SO2/NO2 nonattainment areas, so it answers only half of the per-pollutant severity requirement.
disposition.description: Worst ozone/CO nonattainment classification among matches (Extreme > Severe > Serious > Moderate > Marginal).
disposition.interpretation_hints: Higher classifications carry progressively stricter offset ratios and lower major-source thresholds, escalating air-permit burden for on-site generation. Blank for PM/lead/SO2/NO2 areas (classification is meaningful only for ozone & CO).

disposition.ask: Whether a point is in a maintenance area and which pollutants carry maintenance-plan constraints
disposition.reason: Identifies maintenance-area pollutants but maintenance areas are distinct from nonattainment and do not directly answer the nonattainment classification decision (though they do signal anti-backsliding NSR obligations).
disposition.description: Comma-joined distinct pollutant names for which the point is in a maintenance area (e.g. "Ozone (2008),CO").
disposition.interpretation_hints: Identifies which criteria pollutants carry anti-backsliding maintenance-plan constraints at the point. Empty when the point is in no maintenance area.
